s: It is Friday, and today is review day.
No new words today, just a review of the last three days.
Fifteen words, all in one kitchen story.
My kitchen story starts two days ago.
Two days ago, I bought beans and beef at the market.
I made a big pot of beans with beef.
Then I had beef again yesterday for lunch.
I think I love beef a little too much.
I always say the same thing about beef.
You always cook beef when guests come.
I always enjoy cooking for friends.
Two days ago, I bought an aubergine too.
I cooked the aubergine with tomatoes.
The aubergine was so soft and tasty.
Hmm, I should buy an aubergine too.
Do I add salt to the aubergine?
I always add garlic to my vegetables.
So I add salt, I add oil, and I always add garlic.
And in the afternoon, we ate on the balcony.
The balcony with the great view?
In the afternoon, the sun was warm, so we sat on the balcony.
The balcony is my favorite place in the afternoon.

Last month, my friend was always at the top.
She always scored more points than me.
Last week, my balcony was too hot.
My apartment's air conditioning is very good.
Air conditioning is wonderful in summer.
Do you run the air conditioning all day?
I turn the air conditioning on in the afternoon, and at night I open the window.
I remember your kitchen blinds from a month ago.
Oh, the blinds above the sink.
Two months ago, I bought new blinds.
The blinds keep the kitchen cool.
I always say I will buy blinds, and I never do.
Four times a month, I clean my blinds.
I do it four times a month because the kitchen gets dusty.
I visit my grandparents four times a month, but I never clean my blinds four times a month.
We must talk about the barbecue.
Last Saturday, we had a barbecue in the garden.
A barbecue with friends is always fun.
We had a barbecue two weeks ago, and it was great.
At the barbecue, we cooked beef and aubergine.
Beef and aubergine at a barbecue are perfect.
Speaking of rest, last month I bought a warm blanket.
A blanket is great for cold evenings.
Two days ago, I watched a movie with my blanket.
I always take my blanket to the sofa in winter.

A good bin is part of a clean kitchen.
Last time, I looked for the bin in your kitchen.
The bin is under the sink now.
Two weeks ago, I moved the bin there.
The bin is small but useful.
I always empty the bin at night.
And in April, my kitchen will look different.
In April, I want to paint the kitchen.
In April, the days are longer.
April is a great month for change.
Two days ago feels like yesterday, and two months ago feels like a year ago.
So, let's review what we did today.
We talked about beans and beef from two days ago.
We talked about the aubergine, and how to add salt, oil, and garlic.
We sat on the balcony in the afternoon, with the air conditioning story and the blinds.
We cleaned the blinds four times a month, had a barbecue, and relaxed with a warm blanket.
And we found the bin, and dreamed about April.
